createTokens.title: Create new tokens
createTokens.intro: You can use the {link} for the easiest token creation, or you can use the built-in process below for fine-grained control.
createTokens.needBch: Need BCH in wallet to create tokens
createTokens.noUtxos: Currently the wallet does not have any UTXOs capable of token creation.
createTokens.fungibleDescription: Fungible Tokens is used to create interchangeable tokens. The total supply of fungible tokens needs to be determined at creation.
createTokens.mintingDescription: Minting NFT is used to create an NFT collection. The minting NFT has the ability to mint new NFTs with the same tokenId.
createTokens.mintingNote: Note: to use a Minting NFT toggle the option "Enable mint NFTs" in the developer settings.

createTokens.metadataIntro: To add metadata to your token you need to upload the token image(s), create a JSON file following the {link}, upload it somewhere and then post that link on-chain.
createTokens.selectUploadLocation: Select where to upload your metadata (IPFS recommended):
createTokens.metadataNote: Note: Token metadata can still be added/updated after creation with the token's AuthUTXO. To use this functionality toggle "Enable authchain resolution" in the developer settings. Transfer the AuthUTXO to a dedicated wallet right after creation.

aboutCashonize.title: About Cashonize
aboutCashonize.description: Cashonize is an easy-to-use, multi-platform Bitcoin Cash wallet.

hdAddresses.title: HD Wallet Addresses
hdAddresses.intro: An overview of all the wallet's addresses, grouped by unused and used.
hdAddresses.infoReceivingChange: Receiving addresses are the addresses you share to get paid. Change addresses are used internally: when sending a transaction, the wallet returns the leftover change to a fresh change address of its own.
hdAddresses.infoPrivacyNote: Using a new address for each payment helps protect your privacy.

addressManagement.markAddressUsedAction: Mark address as used and show fresh one
addressManagement.markAddressUsedNote: Previous addresses keep working. You can unmark addresses on the HD Addresses page.
addressManagement.markLimitNotify: Cannot mark this address, one fresh address has to stay available. Receive a payment to free up more.
addressManagement.markingIntro: Receiving addresses can be marked as used after sharing them.
addressManagement.markedInfo: An address you shared stays unused until a payment arrives, so the wallet keeps handing out the same one. Marking it as used moves on to the next address, so every payer gets a different one.
addressManagement.unmarkInfo: Marked addresses are grouped under used addresses, where you can unmark them.

transferAllAssets.title: Transfer All Assets
transferAllAssets.description: Move all BCH and tokens from this wallet to another address.
transferAllAssets.usageHint: Useful to move everything to a new security setup, such as a wallet with fresh backups or a multisig vault, or to consolidate funds and tokens from several wallets into one.
transferAllAssets.usageHintNote: When moving away from a device you no longer trust, create the new wallet on a different device.
transferAllAssets.emptyWallet: This wallet holds no BCH or tokens to transfer

requestPayment.description: Create a payment request to share with whoever is paying you.
requestPayment.descriptionToken: Create a request for a fungible token to share with whoever is paying you.
requestPayment.bip21Hint: BCH payment requests use BIP21, a long standing URI standard that BCH wallets widely support.
requestPayment.tokenStandardHint: Token requests add the token category and the amount to the address, the way the newer PayPro standard for CashTokens describes.
requestPayment.tokenStandardHintNote: NFTs cannot be requested this way.
requestPayment.amountNote: Payment requests fix the {network} amount. The {currency} value can still change before the request is paid.

exportXpub.title: Export Xpub
exportXpub.description: An xpub lets another app watch this wallet, without being able to spend.
exportXpub.usageHint: A watching app can see the wallet's balance and full history and generate new receive addresses. Useful for a portfolio tracker or a watch-only copy on another device.
exportXpub.usageHintNote: Connecting an app over WizardConnect already shares xpubs with it in the background.
exportXpub.privacyWarning: Whoever has your xpub can see all of this wallet's addresses and transactions, past and future. Sharing it cannot be undone. Only share it with services you trust with your full financial history.
exportXpub.safetyHint: A watch-only wallet made from this xpub cannot spend your funds.

signVerifyMessage.title: Sign / Verify Message
signVerifyMessage.descriptionSign: Sign a message with an address of your wallet to prove you control it.
signVerifyMessage.descriptionVerify: Check that a message was signed by a specific address.
signVerifyMessage.usageHint: Some services ask you to sign a message to prove an address is yours, for example an exchange linking a withdrawal address to your account. A signed message also lets you prove you control the funds on an address without moving them.
signVerifyMessage.safetyHint: Signing a message does not give access to your funds: the wallet only signs specially prefixed text, which is never valid as a transaction.
signVerifyMessage.usageHintNote: Only sign messages you understand, a signed message can be shown to others as proof.
signVerifyMessage.selectAddressHint: Choose which address to sign with
signVerifyMessage.addressPlaceholderVerify: Address the message was signed with
signVerifyMessage.shareHint: To let others verify the signature, share the message, address and signature together, unless they already know the message and address.
